unzip.build:
# DEFINES, make, and install args from Debian
DEFINES='-DACORN_FTYPE_NFS -DWILD_STOP_AT_DIR -DLARGE_FILE_SUPPORT \
  -DUNICODE_SUPPORT -DUNICODE_WCHAR -DUTF8_MAYBE_NATIVE -DNO_LCHMOD \
  -DDATE_FORMAT=DF_YMD -DUSE_BZIP2 -DNOMEMCPY -DNO_WORKING_ISPRINT'

%make -f unix/Makefile \
  D_USE_BZ2=-DUSE_BZIP2 L_BZ2=-lbz2 \
  LF2="$LDFLAGS" CF="$CFLAGS -I. $DEFINES" \
  unzips
unzip.check:
./unzip testmake.zip -d test
grep -q "This file is part of testmake.zip" test/notes

urw-base35-fonts.install:
%install_dir %(installroot)%(datadir)/fonts/urw-base35

cp -v fonts/*.ttf %(installroot)%(datadir)/fonts/urw-base35
cp -v fonts/*.otf %(installroot)%(datadir)/fonts/urw-base35

# fontconfig
%install_dir %(installroot)%(datadir)/fontconfig/conf.default
%install_dir %(installroot)%(datadir)/fontconfig/conf.avail

for item in fontconfig/*.conf ; do
    %install_file ${item} %(installroot)%(datadir)/fontconfig/conf.avail/69-$(basename ${item})
    ln -srv %(installroot)%(datadir)/fontconfig/conf.avail/69-$(basename ${item}) %(installroot)%(datadir)/fontconfig/conf.default/69-$(basename ${item})
done

usbguard.install:
%make_install
%install_dir %(installroot)%(datadir)/factory
mv %(installroot)/etc %(installroot)%(datadir)/factory/.
rm -rf %(installroot)/var

# Install mutable rules via factory
%tmpfiles "C /etc/usbguard - - - -"
%tmpfiles "D /etc/usbguard/rules.d 0755 root root -"
%tmpfiles "D /var/log/usbguard 0755 root root -"

usbmuxd.install:

# userdb pls

%install_file %(pkgdir)/usbmux.user %(installroot)%(libdir)/userdb/usbmux.user

uutils-coreutils.install:
%cargo_install coreutils

%install_dir %(installroot)%(datadir)/bash-completion/completions
%install_dir %(installroot)%(datadir)/zsh/site-functions
%install_dir %(installroot)%(datadir)/fish/vendor_completions.d
%install_dir %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1

for item in $(./%(cargo_target_dir)/coreutils --list); do
    case $item in
        uptime|kill|more|hostname)
            continue
            ;;
        *)
            # Install binaries
            ln -v %(installroot)%(bindir)/coreutils %(installroot)%(bindir)/${item}

            # Breaks ZSH completions
            if [[ $item == "[" ]]; then
                continue
            fi

            # Install completions
            ./%(cargo_target_dir)/uudoc completion ${item} bash > %(installroot)%(datadir)/bash-completion/completions/${item} && [ -s %(installroot)%(datadir)/bash-completion/completions/${item} ] || rm -f %(installroot)%(datadir)/bash-completion/completions/${item}
            ./%(cargo_target_dir)/uudoc completion ${item} zsh > %(installroot)%(datadir)/zsh/site-functions/_${item} && [ -s %(installroot)%(datadir)/zsh/site-functions/_${item} ] || rm -f %(installroot)%(datadir)/zsh/site-functions/_${item}
            ./%(cargo_target_dir)/uudoc completion ${item} fish > %(installroot)%(datadir)/fish/vendor_completions.d/${item}.fish && [ -s %(installroot)%(datadir)/fish/vendor_completions.d/${item}.fish ] || rm -f %(installroot)%(datadir)/fish/vendor_completions.d/${item}.fish

            # Now install manpages
            ./%(cargo_target_dir)/uudoc manpage ${item} > %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/${item}.1 && [ -s %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/${item}.1 ] || rm -f %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/${item}.1
            ;;
    esac
done

declare -a _gnu_utils
# https://github.com/uutils/coreutils/issues/10862
# https://github.com/uutils/coreutils/issues/14549
# TODO: revisit again with v0.13.0
# Upstream patch is not accounting umask 0022 yet, hence use gnu-cp for now
_gnu_utils+=(cp)

# https://discourse.ubuntu.com/t/an-update-on-rust-coreutils/80773
# use gnu-coreutils for apps having remaining open TOCTOU (time-of-check to time-of-use) issues
_gnu_utils+=(mv rm rmdir)

for i in ${_gnu_utils[@]}; do
    rm -v %(installroot)%(bindir)/${i}
    ln -sv gnu-${i} %(installroot)%(bindir)/${i}
done

%install_dir %(installroot)%(docdir)/%(name)
TRANSITION="This is a transitional package. Please use uutils-coreutils"
echo "${TRANSITION}" > %(installroot)%(docdir)/%(name)/TRANSITION
echo "${TRANSITION}-dbginfo" > %(installroot)%(docdir)/%(name)/TRANSITION.dbginfo

uv.build:
maturin build %(options_cargo_release) --compatibility linux --out dist
maturin build %(options_cargo_release) --compatibility linux --out dist -m crates/uv-build/Cargo.toml

mkdir completions
_uv="%(cargo_target_dir)/uv"

$_uv --generate-shell-completion bash > completions/uv
$_uv --generate-shell-completion zsh > completions/_uv
$_uv --generate-shell-completion fish > completions/uv.fish
uv.install:
# Install python libs & binaries
%pyproject_install
%cargo_install uv uvx

# Completions
%install_file completions/uv -t %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)
%install_file completions/_uv -t %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)
%install_file completions/uv.fish -t %(installroot)%(fishcompletionsdir)
